Only append-only technical_only=true measurement exclusions remove the denominator; Skip, No Match, BAD, no-action, Baseline Keep, and scope expansion remain. Product owner approved: only an explicit user attestation after real-world action begins may invoke server-authoritative start_execution and transition ACCEPTED to STARTED. recommendation_accepted and external_open never imply start; URL/time inference is prohibited. Record allowlisted attestation method/UI version metadata; use server time for ordering, retain idempotency, and append ABORTED rather than erasing a started record. The sole GAL start evidence is this server transition.

Product owner approved: Japan P0 admits only self-attested age 18+ users with anonymous opaque identity; no DOB, email, phone, or exact location is collected. Before enrollment, record adult_attested_at plus immutable privacy-notice and proof-consent versions/timestamps. User-facing copy avoids internal terms: service provision and use-status review/improvement, anonymous ID, and in-app operations/choices/execution/results; participation begins with consent. Retain user-linkable proof events and consent evidence through cohort closed_at + 18 months, then delete them and retain only non-reidentifiable aggregates. Withdrawal stops future participation/collection; already accepted records remain for the stated audit/verification period. Never fingerprint, link, or restore a lost identity; a new identity does not rejoin the prior proof denominator.

Product owner approved initial provisional policy: max_cards_per_moment=3; sample optional Skip-reason prompt at 25% of skips with an explicit no-answer path; prompt one optional completion/discovery question for 100% of completed executions during Calibration; revalidate context after 30 minutes or explicit user correction; always show 1-3 coarse Fit Receipt reasons; any material change requires a new policy version and a fresh cohort. Skip/discovery diagnostics do not alter primary success measures.

Product owner approved initial Seed release policy: Human GO >=30; each Bootstrap Archetype CORE >=3; each Archetype Semantic Cluster >=3; Weighted Bootstrap Coverage >=80%; unresolved REVIEW=0; complete metadata/hash checks; and synthetic fixtures covering at least 4 of 5 Moment Modes plus meal/rest cases. Store all gates in a versioned coverage policy; any material revision uses a new policy/config/cohort. Detour stays qualitative with no minute/distance constants: NONE means virtually no change to the current place/plan, SMALL means a small detour or schedule adjustment, and OPEN means detour magnitude is not the main constraint.
